abilities.name: Quick Draw
abilities.description: When a fight starts, you can draw and act before anyone who was not already holding a weapon.
abilities.cost: Only the first action of a fight

growth.grows: how fast a rival you can beat

abilities.name: Horse Sense
abilities.description: Ride a horse you have never met and it trusts you enough to cross water or fire once.
abilities.cost: The horse remembers if you lead it into harm

growth.grows: how wild a horse and how dangerous a crossing

abilities.name: Water Witching
abilities.description: Hold a forked stick over dry ground and sense where water lies within a day's dig.
abilities.cost: The stick must be freshly cut; you are parched afterwards

abilities.name: Brand Reader
abilities.description: Read a cattle brand and know which ranch owns it and whether it has been altered.

growth.grows: how cleverly altered a brand you spot

abilities.name: Campfire Stories
abilities.description: Tell a story by the fire and listeners trust you enough to share their own trouble before they sleep.
abilities.cost: Needs a fire and an evening

growth.grows: how guarded a listener opens up

abilities.name: Wagon Mend
abilities.description: You can fix a broken wheel or axle on the trail with whatever wood is around, well enough to reach town.
abilities.cost: Takes an hour; the fix needs a real repair in town

abilities.name: Dust Reading
abilities.description: Read the dust on the horizon and know how many riders are coming and how fast.

growth.grows: how far off and how exact

abilities.name: Snake Calm
abilities.description: When you meet a rattler or wild dog, you can hold still and calm it until it backs away.
abilities.cost: Sweat through your shirt; it only works if you do not run

abilities.name: Poker Face
abilities.description: Hold your nerve at a card table so no one can read your hand or your intentions.
abilities.cost: Only while you are sitting at the table

growth.grows: how sharp a reader you fool

abilities.name: Lone Rider
abilities.description: Ride alone through hostile country and you can pass unseen if you keep off the trail until nightfall.
abilities.cost: Slow going; you arrive hungry and saddle-sore

growth.grows: how watched the country can be

abilities.name: Gold Glint
abilities.description: Pan a stream for an hour and you can sense whether real gold is upstream.
abilities.cost: Freezing hands; claim jumpers watch anyone who lingers at the stream

growth.grows: how far upstream and how much

abilities.name: Lawman's Stare
abilities.description: You can stare down a troublemaker in a saloon and they back off unless they are already drunk or desperate.
abilities.cost: Fails against anyone with nothing to lose

growth.grows: how dangerous a troublemaker backs down
